svg.data-cpu: Intel Xeon D, 4-core D-1627 on a COMe module (both SKUs); up to 8 cores per datasheet
svg.data-memory: 16 GB DDR4 ECC (both SKUs; up to 32 GB per datasheet)
svg.data-bmc: BMC with 1 GB DDR4, dual 32 MB flash, NC-SI shared port, SOL, IPMI 2.0
svg.data-breakout: 168 x 50GbE, 128 x 100GbE or 64 x 200GbE using breakout cables
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 10GBASE-CR/SR/LR/ER, 25GBASE-CR/SR/LR/ER, 40GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4/ER4, 100GBASE-CR4/SR4/LR4/ER4/DR1/PSM4/CWDM4, 400GBASE-CR4/SR4/FR4/DR4/LR8 (shared guide Port Descriptions); DAC up to 3 m (datasheet)
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232, 115200 8N1, flow control XON/XOFF (labelled IOIOI)
svg.data-usb: USB 2.0 type A, data only (does not supply power)
svg.data-emc: CN (GB/T9254-2008 Class A), EU (EN550032, EN55035, EN300386), FCC, VCCI, CCC

g.data-description: guide Table 1 Front Panel Status LEDs, System row (sign SYS in the table, STAT on the artwork) - Green/Amber alternate blinking (normal operation), Off (no power to system)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: guide Table 1, Fan row - Green On (all fans operating normally), Amber On (one or more fans absent or operating abnormally), Off (no power to system)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: guide Table 1, Power Supply Unit row (sign PSU in the table, PWR on the artwork) - Green On (all PSUs operating normally), Amber On (one or more PSUs absent or operating abnormally), Off (no power to system)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: guide Table 1, Alarm row - Green On (no alarm), Amber On (critical alarm), Amber 1Hz blinking (minor alarm), Amber 4Hz blinking (major alarm)
g.title: led-alm

g.data-description: guide Table 3 Port Indicator Lights - Ethernet port active (left): Green on (link at 1000Mbps), Amber on (link in 10/100Mbps), Off (link down); Ethernet port active (right): Green blinking (link active with traffic), Off (no traffic)
g.title: mgmt
